name: Apply Wood Ceiling Finish
intent: One coat per invocation. Method-gated brush/spray.
doctrine: Slower than wood wall finish due to overhead. FAC_OVERHEAD modifier wired 2026-05-05 — eligibility.overhead=true causes the engine to apply 1.25× time multiplier when the resolved task ps_key contains CEILING. Effective rates: brush=70×0.8=56, spray=175×0.8=140 SF/hr.
